definition_rows.extreme_value_risk: Lower denominator-tail risk than equity-denominator proxies; debt scope and component coverage are the main comparability risks.

definition_rows.potential_double_counting: Low if and only if the two named components are summed once from the same filing. Do not add LongTermDebt, DebtCurrent, or lease-liability tags.
definition_rows.real_estate_suitability: Conditional only. Real Estate debt economics may be meaningful, but the frozen manual requires an explicitly pre-registered RE comparable-liability rule.
definition_rows.semantic_consistency: Narrow debt-capital proxy; clear component definitions but excludes capital leases and other liabilities.

definition_rows.semantic_consistency: Book equity multiplier, not a debt measure. It can be algebraically related to liabilities/equity when the equity concepts align.
